seo.title: Northwind: websites your team can edit
seo.description: Northwind builds fast, multilingual websites that your marketing team can update on its own, without waiting for a developer.

props.heading: Websites your team can edit without breaking
props.subheading: Northwind designs and ships fast, multilingual sites. Your editors change copy, images and layout themselves, and publish in one click.
props.imageAlt: Abstract illustration of a website layout

props.heading: Everything a modern site needs
props.description: A small set of well-built sections, so every page stays consistent and quick to load.

items.title: Fast by default
items.text: Pages are cached at the edge and refresh the moment you publish a change.

items.title: Every language
items.text: Translate each page and keep one structure across all of your locales.

items.title: Your code, your domain
items.text: The site runs in your own repository and your own hosting account.

props.heading: Built around how your team works
props.body:
We start with your content, not with a template. Together we choose the sections you need, then your editors take over and keep the site fresh.

No tickets, no waiting for the next release.
props.imageAlt: Abstract illustration of an open-plan office

items.quote: We publish changes in minutes now, without waiting for a developer.
items.name: Anna Kowalska

items.quote: The site got faster and our editors finally stopped being afraid of it.
items.name: Tomás Rivera

items.question: How long does it take to launch?
items.answer: Most sites go live within a week. We start from proven sections and adapt them to your content.

items.question: Can we edit the site ourselves?
items.answer: Yes. Every page is edited visually in the browser, and changes go live when you publish.

items.question: Is the site multilingual?
items.answer: Yes. Each page can be translated, and visitors are sent to the right language automatically.

props.heading: Ready to start?
props.text: Tell us about your project and we will get back to you within one working day.
